messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje w pralni w Wałbrzychu; pisze po zamknięciu punktu, zwykle wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: czyszczenie trampek, seriale kryminalne, domowe pierogi
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek Wysockiego w Wałbrzychu
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przez najbliższe miesiące urządza mieszkanie po przeprowadzce.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: oszczędna, często bez przecinków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: dopisuje „no dobra”

For each of the 14 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. remont i dom - szukanie fachowca (evening, Sunday)
2. komunikacja i dojazdy - hulajnoga / scooter na minuty (afternoon, Tuesday)
3. pogoda - upał (late night, Tuesday)
4. gry i seriale - film w kinie, krótka opinia (lunch break, Wednesday)
5. gry i seriale - maraton serialu, zarwana noc (late night, Friday)
6. jedzenie i gotowanie - zakupy na obiad, czego zabrakło (lunch break, Tuesday)
7. zwierzęta - ptaki na balkonie / karmnik (late morning, Tuesday)
8. dzieci i rodzina - zebranie w szkole (afternoon, Wednesday)
9. dzieci i rodzina - rodzeństwo, drobne sprzeczki dzieci (early morning, Friday)
10. drobne narzekanie na usługi - infolinia, oczekiwanie (early morning, Friday)
11. gry i seriale - gra, trudny poziom / boss (lunch break, Tuesday)
12. jedzenie i gotowanie - nowy przepis, eksperyment (afternoon, Thursday)
13. komunikacja i dojazdy - rower do pracy (evening, Thursday)
14. komunikacja i dojazdy - zmiana rozkładu jazdy (early morning, Wednesday)

Return a JSON array of 14 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
